filename: ClimSim-Online_ A Large Multi-scale Dataset and Framework for Hybrid ML-physics Climate Emulation.pdf
title: ClimSim-Online: A Large Multi-scale Dataset and Framework for Hybrid ML-physics Climate Emulation
parameterization_target: Subgrid atmospheric physics tendencies (temperature, moisture, cloud liquid, cloud ice, winds) and surface radiative and precipitation fluxes
testbed_rationale: ClimSim-Online is specifically designed as an open benchmark dataset and containerized framework for hybrid ML-physics emulation and online testing in E3SM-MMF. Data is openly hosted on Hugging Face with full code on GitHub.
pain_points: Offline metrics do not necessarily correlate with online stability or skill; small timestep errors compound rapidly.
Unconstrained MLPs lead to catastrophic instability/blowup in coupled simulations within 1-2 months.
Physical inconsistencies and non-conservation of mass/energy; unconstrained cloud formation in stratosphere.
Coupling Python ML frameworks with Fortran ESM codes (resolved using PyTorch-Fortran and TorchScript containers).
Missing some storage/precipitation mixing ratio terms prevents exact closed water and energy mass balance enforcement directly from archived outputs.
extraction_notes: ClimSim-Online extends the ClimSim dataset paper (Yu et al., 2024) with an online coupling and evaluation container pipeline using PyTorch-Fortran and TorchScript. It documents both offline benchmark results across six architectures and online coupling experiments using MLP and U-Net models.
